Version 1.0.1

- Added assets/package.json to manage dependencies.
- Added references/README.md for documentation reference.
- Removed the root README.md, moving documentation details into the references directory.
- SKILL.md updated with enhanced feature descriptions, multi-course support, robust error recovery, and clearer configuration instructions.

MOOC自动学习工具首次发布，支持主流视频课程平台自动刷课：

- 自动识别并逐个学习未完成的课程章节
- 实时输出学习进度，自动处理各类弹窗
- 支持进度保存，可断点续学
- 完成后生成详细学习统计报告
- 灵活配置课程链接、播放等待时长及是否无头模式
